page.overview:
Who is Aamir Khan?

Aamir was later kidnapped by Kamran in an effort to impress Lineage, then exposed to what Kamran thought was Terrigen Mist, expecting his latent Inhuman genes to activate. But whatever it was that Kamran stole from New Attilan, Captain Marvel insisted it was not what he believed, as it did not induce Terrigenesis, though it did grant Aamir the ability to generate psychic force fields, which he used to fight off Kamran.

Whether or not the powers were temporary and wore off with healing and prayer as suggested, or Aamir still retains them, remains to be seen.
